monday.joke_caption: Mom doesn't check the ticker. She checks the pasture.
monday.hook_premise: Most crypto charts look like a roller coaster designed by someone with a personal grudge.
monday.lesson_topic: Why volatile price swings cause panic and how stablecoins provide a calm dock.
monday.glossary_definition: A digital dollar (like USDC) designed to stay pegged to $1.00 so your balance remains steady while the market swings.

tuesday.joke_caption: Dad changed the barn combination again.
tuesday.hook_premise: In crypto, there is no friendly branch manager named Bob to reset your forgotten password.
tuesday.lesson_topic: Why seed phrases must be guarded like physical cash and never saved in phone notes or screenshots.
tuesday.glossary_definition: A master backup list of 12 to 24 words that unlocks your digital vault on any device. If you lose it, you lose access.

wednesday.joke_caption: Blue Twin brought a clipboard to inspect the pasture fence.
wednesday.hook_premise: Everyone hates the fence until wolves start circling the barnyard.
wednesday.lesson_topic: The difference between an exchange holding your funds as an IOU versus holding your own private keys.
wednesday.glossary_definition: Holding your own private keys directly so no bank, third-party exchange, or platform can freeze or misplace your assets.

thursday.joke_caption: Son is trying to buy a latte with cold storage.
thursday.hook_premise: Digital wealth is exciting until the cashier asks why you are waving a flash drive at the card reader.
thursday.lesson_topic: Why crypto needs to work at retail checkout counters and how digital settlement eliminates 3% card swipe fees.
thursday.glossary_definition: The payment rail that lets a retailer accept digital dollars instantly for less than a penny in transaction fees.

meet_the_herd_shorts.personality_hook: Unbothered by red candles, unimpressed by green spikes.
meet_the_herd_shorts.domain: Managing volatility, stablecoins, and emotional discipline.
meet_the_herd_shorts.takeaway: When markets get chaotic, she anchors the pasture in stable value.

meet_the_herd_shorts.personality_hook: Has never clicked an unverified email link in his life.
meet_the_herd_shorts.domain: Hardware security, backups, and scam prevention.
meet_the_herd_shorts.takeaway: If it isn't backed up in steel and kept off the cloud, it isn't safe.

meet_the_herd_shorts.personality_hook: Actually reads the terms of service and compliance filings.
meet_the_herd_shorts.domain: Custody laws, regulatory fences, and consumer protections.
meet_the_herd_shorts.takeaway: Clear rules make the pasture safe for everyone to graze.

meet_the_herd_shorts.personality_hook: Convinced every store in town can run without swipe fees by next week.
meet_the_herd_shorts.domain: Point-of-sale adoption, merchant rails, and real-world utility.
meet_the_herd_shorts.takeaway: Crypto only wins when ordinary people can spend it on lunch.
